questions.stem: An alcoholic was drunk and came to a casualty with semi-consciousness, irrelevant talking, and sweating. When his glucose was measured, it was 30mg/dL. The duty doctor started the patient on glucose, but his symptoms didn't improve. What he should have added to correct hypoglycemia?
questions.solutionHtml:
IV thiamine
  • Thiamine acts as a coenzyme for many enzymes in the glycolysis process.


Harrison's Principles of Internal Medicine, 19th Edition, Page Number: 64-9

questions.stem: Management of a patient consuming two liters of whisky daily presented with acute delirium features. The drug used in the treatment is?

Lorazepam with thiamine

questions.stem: Disulfiram is used in alcohol detoxification. Which of the following statements about Disulfiram is true?

options.label: B
options.text: Should be used in a patient who has a mild motivation to withdraw alcohol

options.label: C
options.text: Taking disulfiram and alcohol, the patient feels drowsy, has chest discomfort, respiratory depression

questions.answerText: Taking disulfiram and alcohol, the patient feels drowsy, has chest discomfort, respiratory depression
questions.solutionHtml:
Taking disulfiram and alcohol, the patient feels drowsy, has chest discomfort, respiratory depression
  • Option: C. Taking disulfiram and alcohol, patient feel drowsy, chest discomfort, and respiratory depression is the accurate answer


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number:421

questions.stem: In the treatment of methanol poisoning, Calcium leucovorin is used because:

options.label: A
options.text: Leucovorin enhances renal excretion of methanol

options.label: B
options.text: Leucovorin reduces blood methanol levels by enhancing its oxidation

options.label: C
options.text: Leucovorin reduces blood formate levels by enhancing its oxidation

options.label: D
options.text: Leucovorin enhances renal excretion of formate

questions.answerText: Leucovorin reduces blood formate levels by enhancing its oxidation
questions.solutionHtml:
Leucovorin reduces blood formate levels by enhancing its oxidation

USE of Folate therapy during methanol poisoning:

  • Calcium leucovorin 50 mg injected 6 hourly has been shown to reduce blood formate levels by enhancing its oxidation. This is a promising adjuvant approach.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology by KD Tripathi, 7th Edition, Page Number: 395

questions.stem: Which of the following drug used for Alcohol detoxification blocks the endorphin activation properties of alcohol?
questions.solutionHtml:
Naltrexone
  • Naltrexone hydrochloride is a relatively pure and long-lasting opioid antagonist. Oral naltrexone has been used to treat opioid dependence for many years and has been approved to treat alcohol use disorders (AUDs).


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition, Page Number: 436

questions.stem: Which of the following is not attributed to in-utero ethanol exposure to the fetus?
